summary: Edit many ScriptableObjects of one type side by side, as spreadsheet rows.
overview: Select several assets of the SAME concrete type and see every one as a row, editable in place — including dragging a different object reference straight into a cell, which works because the cells are real property fields rather than text.
useCases: Comparing and balancing twenty item assets at once.
Spotting the outlier in a set of enemy stats.
Bulk-editing without clicking through assets one at a time.

gotchas.title: One concrete type at a time
gotchas.body: A mixed selection has no common column set. Selecting a base type and its subclasses will not work either.
